description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related factory functions for managing media key system support, including querying supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and retrieving their versions. It also includes utility functions for converting error statuses to strings.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media key system support capabilities, including querying supported key systems, support checks, and version retrieval.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysCapabilities.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaKeyErrorStatus enum values to their string representations.

methods.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory::getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with provided OCdmFactory and OCdmSystemFactory.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key systems by querying the underlying OCdm.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities::getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a specific key system.
